why: Done, but odd-looking: the learner typed the layer name as Wheels in the Layer Properties Manager and moved both wheel circles onto it. AutoCAD layer names are not case sensitive (WHEELS and Wheels are the same layer to every command), but the DXF keeps the case as typed, so the file says Wheels, never WHEELS.

step.title: Put the wheels on their own layer
step.instructions: Make a layer named WHEELS (LAYER), move both wheel circles of the side profile onto it, then save the drawing as toy_car.dxf (SAVEAS > AutoCAD 2018 DXF).
